message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large grey letters. Above the title are the words "POLITISASI KEMATIAN PETUGAS KPPS" and "PENCEMARAN BERAT DI DASAR DANAU TOBA." Below the title is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." 

A large yellow spotlight beam originates from the top center, shining diagonally down to a circular yellow stage floor littered with red roses. Within this beam, the main headline reads "RAMAI-RAMAI HIJRAH," followed by three lines of smaller Indonesian text. 

A single human figure walks from left to right across the spotlight’s boundary. The left half of the figure, inside the light, wears a dark pinstriped suit, a white-cuffed sleeve, and a black shoe. The right half, outside the light in a dark blue background, wears a long purple robe, is barefoot, and has a dark beard and a skullcap. 

The background is a dark blue night sky with a thin yellow crescent moon and small white dots. At the bottom, a red banner contains a barcode, price "RP 45.000," date "27 MEI-2 JUNI 2019," and other small text.
